$code..validate: $code.matches(/^[A-Z2-9]{5}$/) && newData.child('name').isString() && newData.child('name').val().length < 60 && (data.exists() ? newData.child('created').val() === data.child('created').val() : newData.child('created').val() === now && newData.parent().parent().child('exp/' + $code).exists())

$code..write: newData.exists() ? newData.parent().parent().child('t/' + $code + '/created').val() === now && newData.isString() && newData.val().length === 13 && newData.val() >= '' + (now - 86400000) && newData.val() <= '' + (now + 86400000) : data.val() <= '' + (now - 2592000000)
